**Decorator Pattern**

Attaches additional responsibilities to an object dynamically. Decorators provide a flexible alternative to subclassing for extending functionality.
Decorators wrap the original object and add behavior before/after delegating to it. This allows stacking multiple decorators.

data.title: Decorator in C#
Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Decorators are perfect for adding features without modifying existing code.
